about.label: About
paragraphs: I'm a software developer with experience building enterprise applications and custom solutions.
I currently work at Accenture, contributing to projects focused on the development, maintenance and evolution of applications built with the .NET ecosystem and Microsoft Azure.

My experience spans backend, APIs, databases, service integration and cloud deployments. I'm particularly interested in building clean architectures, solving complex problems and making the most of new technologies, including Artificial Intelligence and Agentic AI solutions.

bullets: Design, development and maintenance of enterprise applications.
Building solutions with ASP.NET and .NET technologies.
Deployment and release of applications on Microsoft Azure.
Working with Azure App Services, Azure Functions and cloud resources.
Migration of servers, databases and applications across environments.
Application of clean architectures and design patterns.

projects.label: Projects
projects.note: This work sits on internal and client systems under confidentiality agreements, so I describe the kind of problem and the technologies involved without exposing data, system names or metrics.

items.title: Benefits — Accenture
items.description: Development and migration of the applications behind the benefits area: encryption components, database queries, Excel file generation and business-rule processing to produce consistent, logical results.

items.title: Legacy application migration
items.description: Migrated applications from Visual Basic to ASP.NET and solved client-reported issues at the logic level, building custom applications for each need.

items.title: Bank of America — Data processes
items.description: Built jobs that query databases and process the information consumed by other applications in the ecosystem.

items.title: This site — Portfolio and landing page template
items.description: The site you are looking at: bilingual ES/EN, minimal and responsive, built from scratch with Next.js, React, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS. Content lives apart from the design in JSON files, the PDF résumé is generated from that same data, and the technical SEO is covered with canonical URLs, hreflang, sitemap, structured data and Open Graph. The same structure doubles as a base for landing pages and digital brochures: adapting texts, sections and data to another business is a matter of editing a JSON file, without touching the design.
